correctness.rationale: PASS: In the pure binary-successor language, atomic diagrams plus sets of extension r-types are equivalent to rank-r formulas by characteristic-formula induction, including arbitrarily long Boolean combinations. Source checker.py computes complete structural types on all single cycles n=1..32 for q=1..5, giving thresholds (2,4,7,11,19); the cyclic-gap EF invariant proves that all n,m>=2^q are indistinguishable, extending the finite q=5 table beyond 32. Rotation normalization is an automorphism. Independent direct EF game checks reproduced the rank<=3 small-order pattern; the full rank-five enumeration was inspected as code, not personally rerun as an independent complete computation. Thus the proof combines an exhaustive finite algorithm on a bounded domain and a genuine infinite-tail argument, without inferring the infinite statement from sampling.
